mvp_description: Rental Availability Finder with AI-powered matching for property managers

top_buyers.name: Ashtabula Metropolitan Housing Authority (AMHA)
top_buyers.fit_rationale: Official housing authority serving Ashtabula County with Section 8 vouchers, public housing, and USDA housing programs. Manages significant affordable housing inventory. Would benefit greatly from centralized availability finder and streamlined application portal.

top_buyers.name: DTS Property Management
top_buyers.fit_rationale: Regional property management company serving 15+ Ohio counties with 100+ properties monthly. Offers property preservation, rehab, and junk removal. High-volume operator that would benefit from automated listing management and tenant matching.

additional_contacts.name: Western Reserve Properties
additional_contacts.fit_rationale: Established property management in Madison, OH since 1939. Manages rental homes, apartments, and vacation properties. Full property management including tenant screening and 24-hour maintenance.

additional_contacts.name: Ridgeview Estates
additional_contacts.fit_rationale: Local apartment community in Ashtabula managing multiple units. Structured application process and emphasize quiet, quality living. Would benefit from automated availability tracking.

additional_contacts.name: Tucker Group Property Management
additional_contacts.fit_rationale: Local property management firm offering bespoke investment property strategies. Focuses on maximizing ROI for property owners.
